title: Character Animation Mixer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file that implements a 3D character animation blending and mixing system using Three.js.

## Three.js Import (MUST follow exactly)
In the <head>, use this importmap and import via ES Module in <script type="module">:
```html
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
</script>
```

## Scene Setup
- Background: gradient from 0x667788 (top) to 0x334455 (bottom). Implement this by setting the scene background to a color (0x445566) and adding a large background plane or just use a solid color 0x445566.
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 4), looking at (0, 1, 0).
- OrbitControls enabled, target set to (0, 1, 0).
- DirectionalLight at (3, 5, 3) intensity 1.2, casting shadows. AmbientLight at 0.4.
- Ground plane at y=0, 10x10, color 0x555555 with grid helper overlay (GridHelper size 10, divisions 10).

## Character Model (RobotExpressive.glb)
- Load RobotExpressive.glb using GLTFLoader from path './RobotExpressive.glb'. This model contains multiple animation clips.
- The model should be positioned at origin, standing on the ground plane.
- Enable shadow casting on the model meshes.
- After loading, extract all AnimationClip objects from the GLTF data (gltf.animations). Store their names.
- Create a THREE.AnimationMixer for the model.
- For each clip, create an AnimationAction via mixer.clipAction(clip). Initially, only the first clip should be playing (weight=1), others have weight=0.

## Animation Blending System
- Display up to 3 animation slots. Each slot corresponds to one animation clip.
- Each slot has:
  - A dropdown (id='select-anim-0', 'select-anim-1', 'select-anim-2') populated with all available clip names. Default: slot 0 = first clip, slot 1 = second clip (if exists), slot 2 = third clip (if exists).
  - A weight slider (id='slider-weight-0', 'slider-weight-1', 'slider-weight-2'), range 0-1, step 0.01. Default weights: slot 0 = 1.0, slot 1 = 0.0, slot 2 = 0.0.
- The AnimationMixer blends actions according to their weights. When a weight slider changes, update the corresponding action's weight in real-time.
- All active actions (weight > 0) play simultaneously and blend additively.

## Crossfade
- Button id='btn-crossfade-01': Crossfade from slot 0 to slot 1 over 1 second. During crossfade, slot 0 weight lerps from current to 0 and slot 1 weight lerps from current to 1.
- Button id='btn-crossfade-12': Crossfade from slot 1 to slot 2 over 1 second.
- During crossfade, the weight sliders should visually update to reflect the changing weights.

## Playback Controls
- Button id='btn-play': Play all actions.
- Button id='btn-pause': Pause the mixer (set mixer.timeScale = 0, or stop updating).
- Slider id='slider-speed': range 0.1-3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0. Label 'Playback Speed'. Controls mixer.timeScale.

## Skeleton Helper
- Button id='btn-skeleton': Toggles a THREE.SkeletonHelper overlay on/off. When on, the skeleton wireframe is visible over the character mesh. Default: off.

## Controls Summary
- select-anim-0, select-anim-1, select-anim-2: Animation clip selection dropdowns.
- slider-weight-0, slider-weight-1, slider-weight-2: Weight sliders for each slot.
- slider-speed: Playback speed slider.
- btn-crossfade-01, btn-crossfade-12: Crossfade buttons.
- btn-play, btn-pause: Playback controls.
- btn-skeleton: Toggle skeleton helper.
- Keyboard: 'p' toggles play/pause, 's' toggles skeleton.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Position: top-left, semi-transparent dark background, padding 12px, monospace 14px, white text.
- Sub-elements:
  - id='hud-clip0': name and weight of slot 0 animation.
  - id='hud-clip1': name and weight of slot 1 animation.
  - id='hud-clip2': name and weight of slot 2 animation.
  - id='hud-speed': current playback speed.
  - id='hud-time': current mixer time.
  - id='hud-skeleton': 'ON' or 'OFF' skeleton state.

## State Management
Every frame, update window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- frameCount (int): incremented each frame.
- clipNames (array of strings): names of all available animation clips.
- activeClip0 (string): name of clip in slot 0.
- activeClip1 (string): name of clip in slot 1.
- activeClip2 (string): name of clip in slot 2.
- weight0 (float): current weight of slot 0.
- weight1 (float): current weight of slot 1.
- weight2 (float): current weight of slot 2.
- playbackSpeed (float): current mixer timeScale.
- mixerTime (float): current mixer time.
- skeletonVisible (boolean): skeleton helper visibility.
- mixerValid (boolean): true if weights are all finite, in [0,1], and at least one weight > 0.
- isPaused (boolean): pause state.
physics_constraints: Animation weights must sum to produce visually coherent blending. Crossfade must linearly interpolate weights over the specified duration. Mixer time advances proportional to timeScale * deltaTime.
